content.value_statement: Agent teams need repeatable ways to measure quality, regressions, and context changes. This skill guides rubric design, test sets, scoring, and monitoring for agent evaluations.
actual_capabilities: Provides rubric dimensions for factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, and tool efficiency.
Explains weighted scoring, pass thresholds, and trend tracking for agent quality.
Guides test set design across simple, medium, complex, and extended tasks.
Describes LLM-as-judge, human review, and end-state evaluation methods.
Includes a Python evaluator example for simulated scoring and summary reports.
limitations: The included evaluator script uses simple heuristics and simulated outputs, not production-grade judging.
It does not connect to live models, datasets, dashboards, or monitoring systems by itself.
Rubrics and thresholds require domain-specific calibration before release gates.
It does not prove fairness, safety, or factual correctness without representative test data.

use_cases.title: Set Release Gates for an AI Feature
use_cases.description: Create rubrics and pass thresholds before shipping a new agent workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare Agent Configurations
use_cases.description: Measure whether prompt, model, tool, or context changes improve outcomes.

use_cases.title: Build Regression Coverage
use_cases.description: Design test sets that catch quality drops across common and edge-case tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Rubric
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one agent task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple evaluation rubric for my agent task. Include quality dimensions, clear scoring levels, and a pass threshold.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a test set for this agent workflow. Include simple, medium, complex, and extended cases with expected outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Agent Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two agent configurations using an evaluation plan. Define metrics, sample size, scoring approach, and decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design Continuous Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a continuous evaluation pipeline for a production agent. Include sampling, human review, trend tracking, alerts, and regression gates.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a research agent that answers questions with citations.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a rubric covering factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, and tool efficiency.

output_examples.input: Check whether a new prompt improves support-agent responses.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a baseline, a matched test set, weighted scores, and a pass threshold for regression comparison.

output_examples.input: Plan monitoring for a deployed agent workflow.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest sampled evaluations, dashboards, trend analysis, alerts, and periodic human review for edge cases.

best_practices: Start with small representative test sets, then expand after the largest quality gaps are visible.
Use multi-dimensional rubrics and keep human review for subtle or high-impact failures.
Track baseline scores over time so prompt, model, and context changes are measurable.
anti_patterns: Do not grade agents only by the exact steps they took to reach an answer.
Do not rely on one aggregate score when different quality dimensions matter.
Do not run evaluations only after incidents or major quality complaints.

faq.question: What does this skill help evaluate?
faq.answer: It helps evaluate agent outputs, tool use, citations, completeness, and regressions across changing configurations.

faq.question: Does it run a complete evaluation platform?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example code, but production systems need integration work.

faq.question: Can it compare Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide comparison design when the same tasks and scoring rules are used.

faq.question: Should I use human review with this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. Human review is recommended for edge cases, safety concerns, and high-impact decisions.

faq.question: What metrics does it emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, tool efficiency, and pass rates.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production monitoring?
faq.answer: It can help design monitoring, but it does not provide a ready production dashboard.
